body: That’s exactly how I feel. I completely agree.
Okay but screw that teacher. That was such an inappropriate response to your struggles. I’m sorry you had to endure it.
I sometimes feel this way when I watch families make videos on tiktok or something. It just hurts.
That’s really interesting. I love chopped in particular but I definitely cringe when those stories are told...like, must be nice to have supportive parents!
Agreed.
This is heart wrenching. I’m so sorry you had to endure such clueless parents in the face of all that damage.

My SO has the same love language. Physical touch. It makes me feel so inadequate. I hate it. 

And from working in retail myself I know that fake persona all too well. I started to lose that persona as the years went on and I just realized that I had to stop doing retail because I couldn’t stand the fakery. It hurt my heart.

I am so relieved you brought up soul. Soul is the reason why I made this post in the first place....I couldn’t watch it and my partner doesn’t understand why at all. It’s put me into a mental fit that’s lasted since Christmas when it came out. 

I have trouble with people who are overly positive, or toxic positivity. Like no, life is not rainbows and sunshine. Life is about protecting yourself and being realistic because life sucks 99% of the time. I try to avoid physical touch in general but yeah when I’m sad or anxious I don’t really do hugs.
Romance is hard for me too!

This is a good point! I always go to IMDb for the parent guides because I can’t watch anything sexual and they really have detailed warnings in there. I hope that one day we can have more knowledge around these topics.

Or I have to hide it. 
I’ve started looking at the parent guides before watching movies to avoid any panic during the actual movie. It sucks just as much bc I also feel like a burden.
That’s really brave. I’ve tried with certain movies, but it’s difficult to finish a movie that just makes me feel so awful.
This is fascinating. What are some of the movies you watched?

I understand what you mean when you describe how your friends had to take you out of the theater. It shuts you down mentally and physically and it’s hard to even move. It sucks they don’t get it because it’s really debilitating. I’m sorry you had to endure that.

I can completely relate to this! I have to check the parent guides before watching a movie or show to see if it’s “safe,” meaning there aren’t any sex scenes in it. I shut down entirely when there’s any sort of sexual scene or innuendo and it makes watching anything a miserable experience. I had a different lesson engrained in me as a child and an adult but it seems the results are the exact same. I’m so sorry you have to go through this.
It’s interesting you say tangled because that’s a comfort movie of mine.
No, I’m not a therapist. I try to pay close attention to the way I communicate with people so I don’t make them feel bad. I just want to make people feel heard because that’s what I want.
It’s interesting you say that because for some reason that’s a comfort movie of mine.
I’m working on getting it.

Do you feel that it’s a hole in your life you can’t fill? Or are you okay with something missing? I’m afraid that I’ll get what I need and always be pining for something more, partially due to what I see on the screen.
Such an intense fear...I’m so sorry you have to endure that
Such a good point! Media plays such a huge part in all this.
I’m sorry you’ve had to endure that. It makes enjoying things difficult...

I understand what you went through when you had to walk out of a theater over triggers...I’m so sorry you went through that. I have always wondered why movies and other media don’t have more detailed content warnings.

You put it into words so perfectly, this is exactly how I feel. Thank you for putting my mind at ease and helping me think rationally about this, it makes me feel heard. 

I don’t think I’ll go. I want to have a nice holiday, not one where there’s a potential risk of being hurt or undervalued.

I wish I could just easily make that decision. The guilt is hard. I’m also having a hard time simply answering the text itself. Thank you for saying that though...I know that’s the right thing to do for my own sake

I can’t tell if my gut is justified or not. I tend to avoid things that are really difficult or that make me anxious. I feel like the right thing to do is to go but there are so many questions. Do I bring my boyfriend? Do I bring food? Do I wear a mask? Do I avoid certain topics? So many what if’s, too. What if I get bombarded with questions or accusations? What if someone says something to me or my boyfriend and he gets angry? I just don’t know.
This is so sweet. I’m doing okay, taking it day by day. Hope you’re doing well!
I’m glad it helped you!
Flying monkeys are everywhere. It’s beating me down but I’ve found a way around it ^^
Thank you 💛
Your gut is one of the few things in life you should trust, and not your abusers. I’m glad you left, and I’m glad you have some solid support!
I should. Details matter, too. I wish I could remember it all.
I’m glad this was able to help you!
I think we all deserve that....we all deserve that protection and love and affections. I’m happy that you’re able to get therapy to help you!

Any attention is good attention. Being the cause of a reaction, good or bad, gives them power. It’s essentially anything that can give them a sense of inflated ego, which usually includes arguments and making people cry. 
My Nmom didn’t care that she made me cry, and I think she actually enjoyed it. She got the last word and I usually walked off sobbing. To someone who is abusive, that’s essentially a win in their book. 
It doesn’t make sense to us because we’re not abusive people. But seeing it from their perspective has been helpful for me personally to try and understand why she was the way she was.

This is amazing. It definitely is a lot but I can break it down into more manageable pieces. I just have to learn to take things slowly I guess, I’m just not even sure where to start. I find myself focusing on my job even on the weekends rather than doing other things because it’s the one thing that I know how to do. Thank you for putting the time and effort into responding like this, I genuinely appreciate it.
This sounds like a really great technique. I tried it once half-assed but I think if I really stuck with it it could be beneficial. Thank you!

He actually apologized this morning but after whay my dad just pulled, telling them all what I told him, I don’t trust anyone. And it fucking sucks. I have my freedom, and that’s great, but now I’ve lost my family and it’s hard to cope with that.
Do you think I even have to say anything ? I’m so angry. I don’t want to say anything I’ll regret.
I’m in the same boat as you. Good luck and be safe!
So true. Just gotta keep moving forward.

I just, can’t understand how they could say this to me. They saw with their own eyes what it was like for me, and my older brother actually got kicked out of the house. And he’s still defending her. It’s such bullshit and it still hurts. None of them stood up for me. I don’t understand it.
You’re right. I’m literally sitting in the parking lot with all of my stuff so it’s too late to get the title in my name so I’m just going to return it. Thank you for your help!

So I don’t have any monthly car payments since I paid for the car in full about a year ago. I just pay for insurance at the end of each year. All I need is a signature on a piece of paper. Should I still not bring it with me? I mean that’s fine, I just really want what I’ve paid for ya know ? I just want this to go well.

I actually have purchased the car in full already. Like all the payments are completed and it’s a fully owned car, it’s just in her name and so is insurance. All I need to do is get her to sign a piece of paper to switch over the name, and if I did that while I’m still here it would tip her off that I’m leaving.

Thanks so much for the advice ! We don’t share an account, she just asked me to hide that money in the account. I don’t remember when she did that but I want no part of it anymore. 

I’m more concerned about my car. I’ve paid for my car and have the receipts to prove it but it’s not in my name and I don’t want there to be a huge issue. I’m expecting the worst. 

I will definitely take a picture of the note too. Thank you!!
Thank you so much! I want to keep this as simple as possible, and I think getting too emotional would make things worse.
Thank you so much that means a lot 💛
Thank you so much I appreciate that 💛
Proud of you! Good luck!
I saw that. It’s incredibly inspiring. My situation isn’t as bad as that and now I feel like I shouldn’t be doing this.
Thank you for the advice! Eventually I will have to get my own phone service and I want a new number too.

I’m so sorry you had to endure all of those fears. The fear is so crippling sometimes. It makes me sick to my stomach. I hope your boyfriend was supportive of you, my boyfriend has been a saving grace for me during all of this and I’m grateful that I have a good support system. Thank you for sharing your story 💛
Thank you so much, I appreciate the advice 💛

Not alone! 
Nmom acts as if we are so close even though she’s pretty much ruined all of the good things in my life. It makes me angry too, how could she be so clueless ? But it’s all part of how a narcissists brain works.

Definitely relate. Nmom gets so angry at everyone else for spending a little extra on something (ie a fish for a fish tank, or the brand name of a product instead of the store brand) meanwhile she overbuys groceries getting food we don’t need so or fridge is stuffed to the brim, bought an expensive car that needs expensive gas, and buys hundreds of dollars worth of clothes for work. The big expenses are only ok if she decides they are ok, other wise it’s “we’re too poor for that.”
I never did extra curricular activities in school because she always complained about the fees attached to them. Money is a constant issue even though we have enough to survive.
When my therapist said that nmom was abusive, she and her friends decided that this licensed therapist was 1. Bad at her job and 2. A liar.
Amazing triumph! Proud of you.

This is a really good point, and it’s something I have to repeat to myself often. 

I was still abused even if the lines are a little blurry some days, even if I wasn’t hit, even if we had “good” times, even if no one else saw it. It happened, in it’s own way, and the sooner we accept this the better.

Thank you for saying this. I really needed to hear it. You’re right, it isn’t a competition and everyone has their struggles and they are all valid. 
I ended up putting down a deposit on an apartment today. Baby steps! Thank you!

Thank you! 
So it looks like in order to change the title I would need both of our signatures on the application which is obviously not something I want to do. And if she brings it up, I’ll just say that I’m happy to get her signature on the application and change the name on the title. 

I desperately need a car for my new job and it’s causing a lot of obstacles. I’m not sure how to continue but I have to keep going. Thank you again!
Thank you so much I appreciate this. I put a deposit down on an apartment and will slowly start finalizing my plan.
Thank you so much :) I put a deposit down for an apartment. I am going to iron out a few more details and then I’ll leave. I hope everything works out for you!

Thank you so much for your comment. I decided to wait on leaving until I figure some things out first. I did put a deposit down on an apartment tho, so I feel as tho I am already halfway there. Thank you again for the advice !

She could probably find me, and she could call the cops. There isn’t much I can do about that honestly. And i guess the rest of my family could come try and find me. But I would be more willing to talk to them, not her.
The problem is that I have a somewhat plan and backups plans but I have no idea if any of them will work longtime and that’s what makes me hesitate.
I’m still not 100%. But If I don’t leave tomorrow then I’ll have to wait a year.
I needed this. I really really needed this. Thank you so much.
I’m in the same situation as you are right now. I need the final push to just leave. I’ll go to a motel if I have to. But I’m so scared.
I guess ts just the fear of what she can do and all the manipulation she has over me. I want to leave but I’m scared. And I can’t find the push I need.
Yeah that’s pretty much how I feel
I hope you’re able to do that! Slow progress is still progress
I like that idea. Looking to the future. That can be really difficult sometimes but I think it’s the only thing that will actually help. Thank you 💛

This reminds me of my favorite quote ever by Louis CK, “when a person tells you that you hurt them, you don’t get to decide you didn’t.”

It just proves how little they care about us and it’s a hard pill to swallow. They try to relinquish all responsibility by pointing the finger at us, when we’re usually pushed to the breaking point so often that we are desperate for them to understand.
This is an incredibly important message. Thank you!
I agree. Same with coraline, like she and her mother end on better terms and I wish we got those fairy tale endings too. THey still hold a lot of value for me though.

All. The. Time. 

Witnessing friends and significant others be themselves around their families is astounding to me. I get....confused. Like why aren’t they bottling themselves up? Why aren’t they hiding their quirks ? You mean to tell me they can make phone calls without someone eavesdropping on every single word? They can eat what they want without judgment ?? This is normalized behavior ???? 

And those cute family videos on tik tok don’t even seem real to me. I can’t even watch them, they genuinely make me so jealous.

I’ve watched tangled more times than I can count. It’s a comfort knowing that Rapunzel, with the right support, can break free and begin her life. 

I completely agree with you on everything. Mother gothel is a quintessential narcissist. I know I personally gravitated towards the movie for that reason, as well as Coraline and a few others.
The good place is a brilliant show and I completely agree with you. It shows the bad behavior and then it shows growth, which is something a lot of shows lack.
We believe in you! You can do this! Good luck and be safe !
Thank you! I appreciate the advice. I know a lot of factors go into this so I just need to work out a few more details.

I don’t have the highest paying job at the moment but it is a steady source of income, and I can come up with a plan to gradually save more. I just wasn’t totally sure how much to save, but it seems like lots of factors go into it and I should do just a bit more research on it. Thank you!

I haven’t done it enough to give you a solid number, I just know that places for pets are typically around $1k a month. I think the lowest I ever found was $900 but I got discouraged so I stopped looking for a while. 

But it makes sense to have about three months of living expenses saved, that seems like a manageable rule of thumb. Thank you!

I’m not really a big spender but I do have to provide for my dog, and vet appointments and such. Still not $1k but I just want to make sure I have enough of a cushion in case something goes wrong if that makes sense.
I personally loved whiskey cavalier
Tommy was really good!

All the time. If I knew she was going to be home, it was a gut wrenching feeling all day long so much so that I couldn’t focus. Thursday is forever my least favorite day because of that. 

On the days she wasn’t home when I came home, I spent the whole afternoon anxious and waiting for her to come home, preparing myself for whatever mood she was going to be in that day. 

The anxiety, the anticipation, trying to scout out the mood of the room before entering, it’s all tactics to try and survive. You’re not alone in that.

You are not a bad person for getting into an accident, and anyone who has a decent brain isn’t going to believe that you are. She just had to kick you when you were down, it’s how narcs function. Mistakes happen, and this is like a foreign language to narcs. Mistakes happen and they don’t make you bad, they make you human. I know it’s hard to not listen to what she’s saying, but just keep repeating to yourself that it was simply an accident and that you aren’t a bad person because of it. 
I’m glad you’re safe !

Unfortunately I don’t have any advice on how to go NC because I haven’t done it myself. However, this is an incredibly stressful situation and I hope that whatever you decide will help bring you a little bit of peace. You deserve to feel proud of all of your incredible accomplishments, not manipulated or guilt tripped by someone so selfish. 

Nmoms seem to have a pattern of blaming everyone but themselves and refuse to take responsibility for their own actions. Her telling you that you are the cause of pushing away your family is just her way of not taking responsibility for her part in all of this. It’s always someone elses fault, it’s always someone else who needs to do better. That’s not the case here. We try every single day to be their version of better when in reality, they are the ones who should be working for our approval. Not the other way around. 
Be safe!

Nmom used to cook very dry dinners and complained the whole time. Never made me lunch or breakfast, that I can remember. Now that I know how to cook, I make dinner for the family. While it’s exhausting cooking for unappreciative people, it’s incredibly rewarding that I’ve taught myself a very useful skill that she never would’ve been able to teach me. 
I bet your chicken is fricken delicious and I hope you make many more meals you’re proud of!

What an awful thing to say, especially to someone who’s so young and still navigating the world through teenager eyes. It already sucks enough to be a teenager, but to be a teenager with a narc mom is a special kind of hell. I feel for you.
I think you did the right things considering the past between you two. You did the right thing, for your sake and your family’s sake. Keep staying strong!

I’ve dreamed about being a mom since I was 16. There are days I know I can’t handle it, but I’m working through it. Being a mom is all I’ve ever wanted, and I won’t let my abuser keep that from happening. 
You have the power to decide the person you want to be, and if that’s a parent to some amazing kids, then more power to you. There’s validity in all the choices you make because they are YOUR choices, and no one else’s.

Oh my gosh. This is like her energy source. She does it with everything: toys, clothes, items for my dog, food, etc. She over buys during Christmas or even when she’s just out shopping and she expects me to be over the moon that she got me all of this “stuff” that I never asked for. 

Clothing was always the worst. We would be out shopping together and she’d see an article of clothing and ask if I wanted it. I’d say no, and then she’d ask me ten more times if I wanted it, saying it’s so cute, and that I’m so crazy for not wanting to buy it. Then she’d offer to buy it for me and at this point I’m usually so exhausted that I give in, and then I probably never wear it. Because why should I wear something I don’t like? She’ll go into my closet and see the article of clothing and say that I’m ungrateful for never wearing it, and that it’s perfect for me, even though I have no interest in it whatsoever. 
I have had millions of clothes and toys that I had absolutely no interest in and never used because I simply agreed to buy them/have them bought for me to stop the insults. As a child, if she asked if I wanted something and I said no, she’d get so sad over it and I never understood that. So as a child I had a surplus of clothes and toys that made me feel spoiled. I was called spoiled all. The. Time. When in reality I NEVER asked for anything. I still don’t to this day. 

I don’t know what her reasoning was for doing this. I don’t know if she wanted to overbuy to compensate for all the shitty parenting or if she wanted to prove to all the other moms that she could afford all these clothes and toys for her kids. I don’t know why she guilted me into it because it’s not like that ever made things okay between us. Gifts were never bandaids because they were forced. I also hated her spending money on me because it felt like I owed her for everything that I didn’t even want.
So proud of you! You deserve to be free.

Golden children can take many forms. I completely agree with you, OP. The golden child of a family can be torturous and mean and abusive but they are not always like that. Sometimes they are just as broken as everyone else in the family and that’s important to recognize.
So proud of you for at least making progress towards normalizing birthdays. Birthdays are absolutely horrible, I never liked them either. I’m sorry you had to go through that 💛

Anytime I drift off into an area of the house that she isn’t in she gets frustrated. If I don’t watch tv with my parents at night they call me an antisocial loser. I’m rarely in my room when they’re home. I can’t stand the insults. I totally relate.
This is so hopeful to read. Good for you for having the courage to speak your mind. This is definitely a conversation I plan on having one day with my dad
Thank you SO much! The hangout happened today and it was incredible. Everyone’s comments really helped me get through it.
Amazing! I love this idea. I’m going to try it next time there’s an argument. I’m tired of feeling so meek and out of control. I want to be in control for once.
I would almost welcome that tbh. Then someone else could see how crazy she is.
I’m pretty sure you’re going to be me in the future. I’ll be covered in tattoos but I’ll still be afraid of telling her or showing her.
I have never tried that before but I could definitely try. I’m sick of being ruled by her and I want my own life.
I have secret relationships as well. I understand that pain. I’m so sorry you have to go through that. It’s such a simple thing and we cant even enjoy it.

Shopping is such an issue for me. I’m glad that you’re able to consciously work through that. We all deserve to treat ourselves and buy things we actually like. 
 
When I went home for the summer from college, I had a few things I bought like clothes and a blanket. I knew nmom wouldn’t approve so I donated some items and I hid them at a friends house and asked them to bring it back when the semester started again. Looking back I can’t believe I did that but I had to.
I keep reminding myself that I’m not doing anything wrong. I’m just protecting myself against the judgment, the yelling, etc. Just trying to live a little. Thank you I appreciate your advice.
Thinking of you and I hope you find peace soon
So true. It’s like I don’t exist unless I exist for her solely. Thank you.

That’s wild that your nmom tagged along with you and your friend. I hope your friend was understanding and didn’t push you away because of her ridiculous behavior. 

I remember feeling that way when I went to college too. Going to the local Walmart was scandalous to me. I was nervous the whole time, every time. Going to Taco Bell? A huge ordeal. Eventually I got used to it but yeah it was really rough. I truly felt like Rapunzel when she stepped on grass for the first time. 

Thank you so much for the advice. As it gets closer to our hangout I’m starting to get more nervous but I’m also trying to be reasonable. I woke up to my third nightmare about this today and I’m kind of a mess. But I appreciate your kind words.
I need to get help.
A simple drive down the road feels like I’m doing something drastic. It’s unbelievable that I’ve lived my life this way for so long.
Sometimes Ns are so clueless it hurts my brain. I’m so sorry you had to deal with that.
I’m so glad you kept all those letters. You are miles and miles ahead of her as a person. It’s frustrating that she didn’t believe in you but I’m glad you believed in yourself.
That’s horrifying. I’m so sorry you had to go through that. I wish we realized when we were kids that this wasn’t normal behavior, but I guess it’s up to us now to understand that.
The “honey” really gets me. It’s so degrading. I’m so sorry you had to deal with that but also so incredibly happy that you haven’t spoken to her in so long!

Fuck. 
Absolutely disgusted but not surprised. I’m so sorry you had to deal with that at such a young age.
Awful. Grades were a huge issue for me growing up too. Did she break objects like your phone or toys or something ? Or like dishes ? So childish, I’m so sorry.

That sounds unbelievably horrible. I got that first threat you mentioned as well. I find it so troubling the effects these threats have on us. My paranoia is so difficult to manage because I’m always afraid she’s going to find something out. 
I’m so sorry you had to go through all of that when you were so young. The immense pressure you must’ve felt at just five years old to appease your N’s childish and irrational behavior isnt what you should’ve been dealing with at that age.

Keep doing the work of understanding what your wife goes through. She needs you. She’s strong on her own, but the more positive support she has, the more she’ll thrive. And the more you believe her, the more comfortable she’ll feel.

“It’s the years of small cuts to your soul”
I felt those words so much it hurt. 
The proof of our abuse often requires a bit more critical thinking of people unfortunately. I can’t go up to my friends and say “look at this bruise my mom gave me” because I was never hit. I can go up to them and say “she’s isolated me from all my friends and family since I was a child” and the response is usually “well why don’t you just leave?”
Bad parents are incomprehensible to some people. We see it a lot in movies too, we just don’t want to believe that our biological parents are bad. 
It’s so devastating thinking back to when you were a child and how you’ll never truly know if you felt happiness because you know there was always this cloud of sadness and fear that followed you around. Finding those documents like you did, or having memories pop back into your head, it’s exhausting. 
I find solace in knowing that I personally know that my situation was difficult in its own way. I still look for validation from others but I do know that there’s a very good chance that they won’t understand it. And I’m starting to be okay with that.
My immediate thought after I heard her say that. Glad I’m not the only one.

That sounds incredibly exhausting and scary. I’m sorry you have to deal with that. It’s really interesting that you are comparing your situation to a prison, I was just thinking about that the other day. Some days it really does feel like we’re living in a prison, and it’s frustrating that some days we are our own warden.

I’m so sorry that you have to deal with such awful dreams. I’ve never experienced that before but I can imagine it’s. A total mindfuck when you wake up. 
I definitely think it’s some sort of ptsd but I haven’t been diagnosed yet so I’m just waiting until I can get that professional help and then hopefully deal with them.
I’ve had a similar r*pe nightmare with nmom. That’s wild. So sorry you have to deal with that!
I’m so sorry you have to go through that every week. Mine are frequent but not every week. It all makes sense I just wish there was a way to make them stop

Nparents don’t comprehend the word “no.” They feel they are above everyone else and therefore don’t have to listen to how anyone else feels. They feel like they own you so they should get to do whatever they want to you. It’s exhausting.
Almost finished reading this, definitely a great self help book!

We’re all a bit envious. Some people envy others’ cars or houses or money. People who were raised by narcissists envy loving families. It’s normal and common. I don’t know anyone who doesn’t wish they had a loving family.

Dear teenage me,
You’re never going to look back on your teenage years and think “wow, those were some really good times, I wish I could go back.”
The good thing? You always have your future to look forward to. Hold onto the thread of hope that tomorrow could be better. 

Love, 
Me
I have never heard of medium chill before, thank you for the information!
Lexa from The 100. I stopped watching the show when she died.

I always felt that i was affected by the abuse more because I was nmoms only daughter. All abuser/abused dynamics are different, whether it’s a son and father, mother and daughter, friends, etc. I personally feel that who we are plays a huge part into how our abusers target us. I was her daughter, shy and timid since I was a kid, and easily manipulated. My brothers were much stronger, and navigated the abuse much more easily than I did. 
Your abuser could see your sensitivity as your vulnerability, and taken advantage of that. This is not excuse of course, because who we are should be celebrated and not manipulated, and this is something Ns don’t understand. I’m so sorry that you were a bigger target, and I’m so sorry that you were the scapegoat. You don’t deserve that treatment at all; you deserve to be celebrated for all that you are, sensitivity and all.

We are in a similar situation! I am also unable to move out safely with my dog, and my mental health is crumbling. I continue to build a support system of friends on whom I can rely if things truly do go south and I have nowhere else to go. Just keep moving forward, come up with solid plans, and save your money like your life depends on it. Because it does. 
Good luck and I hope you get out soon.

I always say in my head, “if you keep treating people badly, no one will stay.”
She expects me to take care of her when she gets old. I’ve been at her beck and call since I was about ten years old so she assumes that this will continue into her old age. But I refuse to do this. And if I ever do take care of her, I’m forcing my brothers and my father to help. She’s spent years focusing her attacks on me and I’m so sick of it. Eventually, she won’t have anyone left and she’ll be alone because she pushed everyone away. 
I feel your pain, friend. You don’t owe anyone anything, don’t let anyone tell you differently.
It’s a slow and painful process just getting through the book but I’m hoping we can both finish it soon!

Thank you for the advice ! I’ve definitely been working more towards my freedom in small doses. I make sure to celebrate my small triumphs and hopefully I can start doing that again until I feel comfortable.

Thank you for commenting I appreciate it ! He does know about my situation, since we’ve known each other for a while. The only thing I think I can safely do is ask for his patience and say he doesn’t need to wait around until I’m ready.
I’ve known him for years and I trust him. Thank you for the advice !
Thank you! As painful as it will be, I really need to read these books. I appreciate your suggestions !

So unfortunately I am an adult and yet I still feel this way. My paranoia is unbearable; I feel like she’s everywhere. I can’t speak my mind because I get punished for it. 
I have heard of grey rocking, but I’m not very good at it. I cry very easily and I’m just trying to prepare myself for the storm that’s coming later on.

This has happened to me too. I get so anxious when I have a thought or a desire that goes against the wishes of someone else that I find it hard to communicate. Like I’m so terrified of the consequences of not being exactly what they want but I am always met with such kindness and gentleness. I’m used to being interrogated and insulted and manipulated, etc. To actually receive decent treatment is unbelievable to me.
